review_result: Boot phase: copies exactly 0xCB words from CodeFlash 0x8370..0x869B to RAM 0xFEBF1000..0xFEBF132B, reads back the last word, SYNCM/SYNCI. Full copied span and both canaries executed. RAM callback FEBF12B8 maps to ROM 8628 only in this phase; application crypto reuses the RAM. Physical cache timing is not established.

Forward byte-counted copy: r6 destination, r7 source, r8 byte count; returns original destination in r10. Word path requires both pointers four-byte aligned; otherwise byte path. Exact firmware execution covers aligned bulk/tail and unaligned copies, unchanged source, destination canaries and stack restoration. Not an overlap-safe memmove contract.

Byte-counted zero fill: r6 destination, r7 byte count, no return contract. Short unaligned and 128-byte-block-plus-tail paths execute with exact destination and canary checks. Uses byte alignment prelude, 128/64/32/16-byte blocks and word/byte tails; zero count makes no destination write in the separate exhaustive boundary smoke.

For unsigned slot <2 and low-byte result ==1, copy 12 bytes from pending FEBE55F4+12*slot to committed FEBE55DC+12*slot inside the ordinary critical section. Executed second-slot commit, invalid slot rejection, nonboolean result rejection and low-byte truncation; pending source and nesting count preserved. Not rollback and not PDU dequeue.
